# Official Sign in with ChatGPT local SDK

Built without source changes from https://github.com/openai/sign-in-with-chatgpt-devkit
commit `0a36fefeb913055c8c7a1a29b63d82b96b2e841a`, package `@siwc/local` 0.1.0.
The compiled files and upstream notices are retained here so local installs do not
depend on a sibling checkout or an unpublished npm package.

License: Sign-in with ChatGPT DevKit Noncommercial License v1.0 (see LICENSE).
This integration is for personal local validation. Commercial distribution needs
an appropriate license and hosted ChatGPT plan access.
